inclusion_rule: Speech or language decoders from neural or muscle signals (EEG, MEG, ECoG, sEEG, EMG) that train one model on recordings whose channel count or electrode layout differs across participants, devices or datasets, by mapping channels into a shared space (sensor-position spatial attention or coordinate embeddings, per-subject or per-layout input layers, graph models over electrodes, channel tokens, or a common channel subset). Boundary: a model trained and tested on one fixed montage is excluded even when pooled over subjects; channel-subset selection within one array is excluded; auditory-attention and non-speech EEG models are excluded when read; versions of one study count once.
